items.title: 美敦力Hugo手术机器人准备扩大手术规模
items.summary: 美敦力预计，到本财年结束时，Hugo手术系统全球累计手术量将超过5万例。
items.lede: 美敦力Hugo手术机器人累计手术量有望在本财年突破5万例，显示这套系统正进入更大规模的临床使用。
analysis: 美敦力正在推进Hugo手术机器人的商业化，公司预计本财年结束时全球累计手术量将突破5万例。
手术量增长意味着这套系统正从早期试用走向更常规的临床使用，可能为更多医院提供达芬奇之外的机器人手术选择。
目前公开信息只给出累计手术量目标，尚未披露各地区的具体使用情况、与竞品的价格对比以及长期临床效果数据。

en.title: Medtronic's Hugo surgical robot prepares for larger-scale operations
en.summary: Medtronic expects its Hugo surgical system to surpass 50,000 cumulative procedures worldwide by the end of its fiscal year.
en.lede: Medtronic's Hugo surgical robot is on track to pass 50,000 cumulative procedures this fiscal year, a sign the system is entering broader clinical use.
analysis: Medtronic is pushing ahead with commercialization of its Hugo surgical robot, expecting cumulative global procedures to exceed 50,000 by the end of the fiscal year.
The growing procedure count suggests the system is moving from early trials toward more routine clinical use, potentially giving hospitals another robotic surgery option beyond Intuitive's da Vinci.
Public information so far covers only the cumulative procedure target; regional usage details, pricing against competitors and long-term clinical outcome data have not been disclosed.

items.original_title: Medtronic’s Hugo surgical robot ready for bigger operation
items.original_summary: Globally, the Hugo surgical system is on track to surpass 50,000 cumulative procedures by the end of Medtronic's fiscal year.
